verdict.rationale: Rippling ships an official CLI (rippling-cli) with 'Flux' commands for developers to create, manage, and deploy Rippling-hosted integrations, which could be scripted/run in CI, plus general developer APIs and sandbox access — but there is no evidence of headless operation of core Rippling workflows (payroll, HR, benefits) or CI-specific automation patterns beyond integration deployment. missing for 10: documentation of running core product actions headlessly/in CI, CI integration examples, non-interactive auth/token flows for automation pipelines.
